questions.q: What is the flow matching target for one training pair?
questions.why: The derivative of (1 − t) x₀ + t ε with respect to t. It does not change along the line.

questions.q: Why does the loss not reach zero even for a perfect model?
options: Many pairs pass through the same point, so the model can only return their average
The learning rate is too low
questions.answer: Many pairs pass through the same point, so the model can only return their average
questions.why: The floor in the lab is above 1 at every t.

questions.q: A velocity error of δ at time t is what clean-latent error?

options: The model's clean estimate against the latent
The velocity against ε − x₀ directly
questions.answer: The model's clean estimate against the latent
questions.why: fwd_bwd calls loss_fn(x0_pred, x0). On a flow model with MSE that is σ² × velocity loss.

questions.q: How does shift 3 change core's trainer's noise levels?
options: About half the samples have σ above 0.75
questions.answer: About half the samples have σ above 0.75
questions.why: percent_to_sigma bends the uniform draw. The lab measures 0.499.
